name.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab

caption.ja: 光学的厚さ0.7の純吸収平板。32〜512セルのBeer–Lambert参照への空間誤差と、厳密セル内伝播を使う4〜32方向の角度誤差を分けた保存図。
caption.en: Pure-absorption slab of optical depth 0.7: stored 32–512-cell spatial errors versus Beer–Lambert and a separate 4–32-ordinate angular sweep using exact cell propagation.

note.ja: 32〜512セルで全方向の強度誤差・空間フラックス誤差・正値性・離散吸収収支を確認。4〜32方向の別系列は、出射フラックス2pi E3(tau)の解析表示と比較します。
note.en: With 32–512 cells, check all ray intensities, spatial flux error, positivity and discrete absorption balance. A separate 4–32-ordinate sweep compares exit flux with the analytic 2pi E3(tau) representation.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 16〜256セル・4〜64方向を別に収束させ、QUADPACK積分とE3を照合。64seed・1024/4096/16384光子で平均誤差、RMSE、二項標準偏差と95% Clopper–Pearson区間の実測被覆を記録します。全光子の出射＋吸収、正値性と離散フラックス収支を確認します。
note.en: Refine 16–256 cells and 4–64 ordinates separately; compare QUADPACK integration with E3. For 64 seeds and 1024/4096/16384 photons, record mean error, RMSE, binomial standard deviation and observed 95% Clopper–Pearson coverage. Check photon exit-plus-absorption counts, positivity and discrete flux balance.
